subject: gk
question: How many countries participated in the 2016 South Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eight**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2016 South Asian Games had the participation of **8 countries.** These countries were:

 
 
• Afghanistan
 
• Bangladesh
 
• Bhutan
 
• India (host country)
 
• Maldives
 
• Nepal
 
• Pakistan
 
• Sri Lanka
 
 
 
• These games were held in **Guwahati **and Shillong, India, from **February 5 to 16, 2016**, featuring over **2,000 athletes **from the **South Asian region.**
